_description: B5.2 route-agnostic estimator triads. Each case runs one bcc-Fe observable via gf_route = recursion | lehmann | dyson on the SAME converged potential and checks the documented agreement envelopes (see docs/dev/route_agnostic_estimators.md). Run with tests/regression/run_triad.py.

cases.name: triad_bccFe_jij
cases._note: J_ij(1st-NN),(2nd-NN) at 12^3, eta=0.02. recursion~=2x lehmann on 1st-NN (broadening artifact, NOT normalization; B2.6). lehmann==dyson is the tight pin.

cases.name: triad_bccFe_sigma
cases._note: Diagonal sigma_xx near E_F at 6^3, cond_ll=30. Exact k-space moments match the recursion moments to ~0.15% (tight envelope). lehmann==dyson bit-identical (same Sigma=0 eigenpair moment path).
